dedupe_keys.name: building materials and components monthly statistics uk construction material prices and deliveries

description: The monthly statistics of building materials and components give the latest UK figures on construction material price indices and on production and deliveries of key materials, such as bricks, cement and concrete blocks monthly and sand and gravel, slate, concrete roofing tiles and ready-mixed concrete quarterly, with imports and exports of construction products. They are published on GOV.UK by the Department for Business and Trade, whose collection holds 49 releases and was last updated on 16 September 2026 with the August 2026 statistics. The candidate came from a data.gov.uk entry of the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government that combined these material price indices, for new housing, other new work, repair and maintenance and all work (monthly, 2010 = 100), with an index of hourly construction wage costs (quarterly, 2000 = 100) on Open Data Communities, which is no longer maintained. Coverage: the United Kingdom. Access: monthly releases on GOV.UK. Licence: Open Government Licence; free. Caveats: national indices only, and the wage cost index is not part of this collection. Simulation uses: construction and repair cost escalation in retrofit, reconstruction and investment appraisal models. Related records: the Help to Buy statistics and the grid-interactive building technology costs.
